body:
Filing gate ①: a defect with a named location and a reproduction. This is the family close-out card for the #24812 shape. Every remaining position is enumerated below, so the family needs no point cards.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:skills` lane (SKILL.md's lane table: `.claude/**` is governed, Tier S). One PR on `.claude/hooks/**` and the matching `*.selftest.sh`; the seat lands it after an at-tier contract review. Filed by `domain:skills` seat 1 (seat post #7623, `session_01M82feuetLzrCiBz41BJb7L`) from two findings in the #24812 dev's report and PR #24886's Acceptance notes, which the contract review on PR #24886 (comment 6291929083, ③) escalated for filing (AGENTS.md Prime Directive 10). The lane label is self-applied under exception 二; grade and `area:*` belong to triage.

**Dedupe (open and closed), objectstack, MCP `search_issues`** (read 2026-10-20T13:28Z):
- 「guard-shared-stash command substitution nested double quote false block」 → 5 hits;
- 「guard-main-checkout-bash parameter expansion nested quote redirect false block」 → 7 hits.

The hits are #24812 (open, the sibling this card closes out) and the closed #11131, #10570, #11133, #10720, #11234 and #5883. Each of those is a different shape, and none covers these positions.

## What happens

PR #24886 (#24812) gives `guard-main-checkout-bash.sh` one helper, `subst_end()`. Inside `"…"`, a `$(…)` or a backtick opens its own quoting context, so a `"` in its body nests instead of closing the outer string. Two positions of the same family are still open.

1. **`.claude/hooks/guard-shared-stash.sh` `split_segments()`** carries the identical pre-fix in-double-quote branch, with zero occurrences of `subst_end` at PR #24886's head `e4ba00dc9`. Measured by the #24812 dev at `b1676441b`:
   - `echo "a $(echo "x; git stash pop")"` is a pure read, and the guard answers exit 2 (blocked);
   - `echo "x; git stash pop"` answers 0.

   The inner `"` closes the outer string, so the `;` inside the substitution splits a segment, and `git stash pop` reads as a command.
2. **A parameter expansion with a quoted default inside `"…"`**, in `.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout-bash.sh`: `echo "${x:-"a > b"}"` answers exit 2 with `target: b}`, before and after PR #24886. This is not a mechanical extension of `subst_end()`. Inside `"${…}"` a `'` is literal and a `"` nests, so the expansion needs its own rule. The fix may instead be the header's existing promise: any target holding an expansion fails open.

## Enumeration pin (every quote-aware segmenter in the hook directory)

`git grep -nE '^(split_segments|tokenize|strip_line_comment|strip_heredocs)\(\)' origin/main -- .claude/hooks/` on `origin/main` `ad8cf92f0` → 7 sites. The control, `git grep -c split_segments` on the same tree, hits 6 files.

| file | function | status |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `guard-main-checkout-bash.sh` | `strip_line_comment`, `split_segments`, `tokenize` | fixed by PR #24886 for `$(…)` / backticks; position 2 (`${…}`) open |
| `guard-main-checkout-bash.sh` | `strip_heredocs` | reads through `strip_line_comment`; covered by PR #24886's heredoc pin |
| `guard-shared-stash.sh` | `split_segments` | position 1, measured |
| `guard-process-kill.sh` | `split_segments` | NOT MEASURED: the PR measures it and fixes it or pins it clean |
| `guard-tree-enum.sh` | `split_segments` | NOT MEASURED: the PR measures it and fixes it or pins it clean |

## Done when

- Each row above is either fixed (one shared rule per shape, so segmentation and tokenisation agree, the lesson of #11131) or pinned clean, with a self-test case per row.
- Every existing real-write and real-stash control stays blocked.
- `pnpm check:bash32-floor` holds.
- The objectui twins are a separate card (split by repository); this card changes no objectui file.
